blocks.t: DUAL POWER AMP P.C. BOARD MODIFICATION

the master cable in this game was designed for use with the DUAL POWER AMP P.C. Board #A084-90910-F000. When it is determined that the DUAL POWER AMP W/MIXER P.C. Board #A084-91648- A000 is to be used in the game, the following modifications procedure must be used to adapt the master cable to the board.
HOW TO ADAPT MASTER CABLE
STEP 1 - Turn off power to the game and open the rear access door.
STEP 2 - Locate and remove the DUAL POWER AMP P.C. Board from the right side wall (looking from the rear of the game.
STEP 3 - Install the DUAL POWER AMP W/MIXER P.C. Board in the same (relative) location where the DUAL POWER AMP P.C. Board was removed from.
STEP 4 - Locate the Amp To Amp W/Mixer Conversion Cable #AE85-00027-0000 in the game Spare Parts Kit.

STEP 5 - Connect the 8 position header from the Conversion Cable to the 8 position connector on the master cable. Next, connect the 11 position connector on the Conversion Cable to the DUAL POWER AMP W/MIXER P.C. Board connector #Jl.
STEP 6 - Close rear access door and return game to Play Mode.
PARTS & OPERATING MANUAL #0E85-00300-0000. MODIFICATION

The piloterun manual's Cabinet Wiring Diagram #M051-O0E85- A003, page 3-28, illustrates the DUAL POWER AMP W/MIXER P.C. Board installed in the game. Page 3-29 illustrates the DUAL POWER AMP installed in the game.

The production run of the manual!s will] illustrate both P.c. Boards, on page 3-28.The part number for the Wiring Diagram #M051-00E85-A003 will remain the same. The ‘pilot run' Wiring Diagram was 3 pages in length. The 'production run' will be 2 pages in length.
